=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:12, 187 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup-section header directs every stage session to run cleanup in Step 0, contradicting the issue-mode resume instruction to run it after Step 1 reads the plan.
  WHY: An unattended session may attempt cleanup before the `Source issue:` identifier is available and skip archival; other reviewers report that the header and Step 1 instruction have since been updated.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:103, 161 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup and rename logic lacks defined failure-handling paths for transient errors in `set_session_title` or `mcp__github__issue_read`.
  WHY: A rename failure can leave a stopped session with a title the cleanup does not match, and a label-read failure can skip archival without reporting; other reviewers report that failure paths have since been added.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The cleanup must run on a `/reclarify` resume after Step 1 reads the plan and the `Source issue:` identifier is available, with an explicit operational instruction in Step 1.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` Step 1 and cleanup section header
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: Step 1 (line 15) contains no reference to the Zombie-checker cleanup, and the cleanup-section header at line 187 remains unchanged ("Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene"), meaning no operational mechanism fires the cleanup after Step 1; other reviewers report that Step 1 and the header now specify the issue-mode timing.
- requirement: A contract test must pin the issue-mode cleanup trigger's placement after Step 1 reads the plan and verify the cleanup section header distinguishes issue-mode timing.
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py`
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The existing test (`test_issue_mode_archives_stopped_stage_sessions`) only asserts text-string existence and does not assert trigger placement relative to Step 1, cleanup-section header content, or verify an operational hook at the end of Step 1; other reviewers report that the test now pins placement and timing.
- requirement: The lint check (`tests/inventory_parity.py`) must pass for the PR to merge; `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py` must be documented in the `docs/INVENTORY.md` Scripts section or explicitly exempted in `tests/inventory_exemptions.txt`.
  expected_change_site: `docs/INVENTORY.md` Scripts section or `tests/inventory_exemptions.txt`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The lint CI check (`tests/inventory_parity.py`) fails on this PR head, as reported by the task-state context, because `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py` is referenced by `agents.md` but missing from the inventory; other reviewers report that the inventory entry was brought in by a merge of `main` and the check was not failed.
- requirement: When Step 1 reads a plan that lacks a `Source issue:` header line, the issue-mode cleanup must either log/report the skip or be documented as an intentional no-op.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The cleanup-section report line only fires when the count is computable; a project-mode resume with no `Source issue:` line never produces a count or log, so the operator-visible report is indistinguishable from a project-mode resume that has no zombie checkers either; other reviewers report that plans without the line intentionally skip cleanup.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  WHY: The header states "Every stage session runs this in step 0, after resume hygiene", which instructs an unattended session to run cleanup in Step 0. However, the new issue-mode bullet in Step 0 explicitly states "once step 1 has read the plan, run the Zombie-checker cleanup too". An unattended session walking the bullets may attempt cleanup in Step 0 before the Source issue identifier is read, causing it to fail or skip the archival, re-introducing the bug.
